headline: Klabin Q3 Revenue Rises 3% as Cost Pressures Squeeze Margins
summary: Brazilian pulp and packaging producer Klabin recorded a 3% increase in third-quarter revenue, though rising operational expenses squeezed operating margins across paper and packaging product lines.
why: Klabin is Brazil's largest paper producer and exporter, heavily exposed to global packaging demand and pulp price dynamics.

impacts.name: Klabin S.A.
impacts.why: Higher input and operational costs eroded margins despite modest top-line revenue expansion.
